01.name: window_sill
01.prompt:
Image 1 is the STYLE reference (copy its art style only, not its content). Image 2 is the LAYOUT reference: the SAME cozy apartment (same window, curtains, plant, rug, shelf, colours) seen from a new spot. Image 3 is the CHARACTER SHEET of Naomi: copy her exact face, markings and art style for her REFLECTION (but make the grey a clearer blue-grey).

Beautiful Japanese anime illustration in the polished style of a high-quality gacha game / visual novel: delicate clean linework, soft cel shading with smooth gradients, luminous pastel colours, gentle glow and bloom, sparkling highlights, rich fine details, cozy healing (iyashikei) mood. Match the art style of the style reference image exactly.

STRICT FIRST-PERSON VIEW: the camera IS the cat Naomi's own eyes. The camera is LOW, about 25 cm above the surface she stands on, slightly wide-angle. Naomi's body, head and face are NOT in the picture (the viewer is inside her). The ONLY parts of her that show are the tips of her own two fluffy WHITE mitten front paws resting at the very bottom edge of the frame, seen from above, close to the camera. Wide 16:9 game scene. Keep the lower 20 % calm (subtitles go there). No text, no logo, no watermark, no UI.

Seen through Naomi's eyes as she sits on the wide wooden WINDOWSILL on a WINTER morning, looking slightly to the left at the window. LEFT half: the big window glass very close to the camera, with delicate white frost flowers on the lower corners of the pane; outside a pale blue sky and snowy rooftops. Bright golden winter sunlight streams in through the glass from the upper left; a warm sunbeam falls across the sill and across her two white paw tips at the bottom edge. Naomi appears ONLY as a soft, faint, semi-transparent REFLECTION in the window glass: her face looking back at the viewer, close and centred in the glass, her own eyes meeting ours. RIGHT half: the cozy living room seen from the sill height, slightly blurred (round cream rug, low shelf, little cat tower, fairy lights), empty. Cold blue glass on the left, warm gold light on the right: a clear cool-and-warm contrast. Her reflection: 

Her fur colour is a soft BLUE-GREY (cool bluish grey, like a Russian Blue tint, never neutral or brownish grey) with white.

Naomi, a real domestic CAT (an animal on four legs, not a human, not a cat girl, no clothes): a very fluffy long-haired blue-grey and white bicolour cat (Siberian / Ragamuffin type). Soft blue-grey fur on the top of the head, the ears, the back, the sides and the tail, with faint darker grey tabby shading on the flanks; a pure WHITE inverted-V blaze from the forehead down between the eyes to the muzzle; white muzzle and chin; a huge fluffy white chest ruff and white belly; white mitten paws on all four feet; a small soft PINK nose; big round OLIVE-GREEN / yellow-green eyes; grey ears with long white tufts inside; long white whiskers; a very long plush darker-grey tail. Round, chubby, extremely soft and fluffy. Cute anime proportions: slightly big round head, big shiny eyes with sparkly highlights, soft pink blush on the cheeks. Personality: gentle, obedient, a little shy and easy to tease — a sweet, soft, good-natured cat.

Avoid: ukiyo-e, woodblock print, gold leaf, realistic photo, photorealistic fur, 3D render, CGI, horror, gritty, dark muddy colours, text, letters, writing, logo, watermark, signature, frame, border, blurry, low resolution, jpeg artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra tails, extra ears, cat girl, clothes, collar, phone stickers, hearts, showing the owner's face, a cat sitting in front of the camera, the cat's body or head in the scene, more than two paws, neutral grey fur.
